about: Story boss encounters rebuilt from what the client holds (docs/systems/dungeon.md, 'Story encounters'). The original server's encounter scripts and boss behaviour trees (NPCConfig _iAISpecial MainStory_*) are not in the client. What is real: the boss and companion templates (NPCConfig), their skill kits (SkillConfig, named by _kScriptLogic), the skill timelines (data/skills, m_kShows effects and timings), the dialogue (ChatConfig 53xxxxx), the scene-editor points and the quest stages (DungeonQuestConfig). What is chosen here and marked as such: which skills a boss uses and in which order, every hit area and hit time, the stage triggers, the companions' rotations (except the priest, whose tree MainStory_MuShi ships) and when each line is said.

1022001.name: Payon Forest: Eddga
1022001.why: Scene 1022001 (sc_pay_fild10_001_pl01): boss point 20 (boss位置, NpcLevelPointRespawnConfig 5300001 Eddga), Wule at 21 (唔勒), Boya at 23 (保亚), two groups of six adventurer points 24 and 40 labelled 战 猎 奶 商 刺 法 (swordman, hunter, priest, merchant, thief, mage). Two DungeonQuestConfig stages: 1 'Cover Boya and Wule', 2 'Join the Adventurers and defeat Eddga'. The client has two sets of six story adventurers (5300007-09 + 5300070-72, and the '2' variants 5300073-78) and the fighting Wule/Boya templates 5300086/87 with their own skills.

bossSkills.why: MainStory_HuWangSkill1, timeline 53002: Skill1_1 animation, fx_eddga_skill01_flame_xuli charge at 2.5 s. A flame claw in front; the 120 degree, 6 m cone and the hit at 2.6 s are chosen.

MainStory_HuWangSkill4, timeline 53005: fx_eddga_skill_impact_xuli at 1.67 s, fx_eddga_skill_impact 4 m in front (scale 2) and a camera shake at 3.33 s: the jump and landing. A 5 m circle centred 4 m in front at 3.33 s (chosen from that offset).

MainStory_HuWangSkill2, timeline 53003: fx_eddga_skill_shootfire_xuli then fx_eddga_skill_shootfire from the head, two hit marks: a fire breath. A 12 x 4 m strip in front, hit at 3.2 s and 4.4 s, half the damage each (chosen).

MainStory_HuWangSkill3, timeline 53004: Skill1_6 three times, fx_eddga_skill_groundflame_xuli at 2.83 s, mark groups at 0, 2.52 and 5.1 s: ground flames around Eddga. A 7 m circle at 2.9, 5.4 and 7.6 s, a third of the damage each (chosen).
MainStory_HuWangShouting, timeline 53007: fx_mainstoryeddga_buff_roar at 1.5 s and a camera shake. An 8 m roar around Eddga at 1.5 s (chosen); 240% of ATK.

5300008.why: MainStory_FaShi: the mage kit Attack, Fire/Lightning/Cold Bolt. Safety Wall 5331301 is left out (no ground protection for monsters here).

stages.why: 'Cover Boya and Wule': Wule and Boya are already fighting Eddga. Wule asks the player to hold Eddga off while the flare is readied (5300017). Eddga opens on Boya (chosen).

end.why: Chosen: the stage ends when Eddga is down to 60% or after 45 s, whichever comes first.

stages.why: 'Join the Adventurers and defeat Eddga': the flare brings two parties of six (groups 24 and 40), each a full set of the story adventurer templates.
